wordmark.purpose: The serif QuantumLab name in brass, top bar of the viewer and the Operate pages; 24/28 above 1160 px.

title.purpose: Operate page titles; every MUI heading level.

nav.purpose: Top-bar and panel tabs; 600 when current.

body.purpose: Running text and table cells on desktop.

body-phone.purpose: Body under the phone query (max-width 760, max-height 500, or portrait to 1100).

subtitle.purpose: The plain line under the specimen title.

caption.purpose: Table headers, legends, notes, chip and status text; 12 on a phone too.

tick.purpose: Axis labels and band job names; the 11 px floor.

figure.purpose: Any comparable number: body with tabular figures (.ql-tabular).

mono.purpose: Job keys and diagnostic logs on the jobs page; literal stack, no token yet.

wordmark-compact.purpose: Below 1160 px and on a phone.

wordmark-tight.purpose: From 860 px down, and on a phone under 380 px.

specimen.purpose: The name of what is drawn, top-left on the viewing field.

specimen-view.purpose: The view of the specimen, the specimen title's second serif line in text-2 ("whole atom", "3dz² orbital", "preview").

info-title.purpose: The selection's or topic's name at the head of Info; 17 px on a phone too. Its view line under it is the serif at body size, 400, text-2.

body-basics.purpose: Body at the Basics level, every width.

gradients.name: canvas
gradients.purpose: The viewing field behind the transparent canvas.

gradients.name: canvas
gradients.purpose: The light page's viewing field: a lifted charcoal, still dark.

gradients.name: strip-tile
gradients.purpose: A thumbnail tile's subtle lift from the top, in the field's own surfaces.

gradients.name: favicon
gradients.purpose: The brass atom favicon (public/electron-icon.svg); not a UI fill.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Docked panels, budget strip, job list: a hairline top highlight, no drop shadow.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: The same containers, lifted softly in umber.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, search results, the phone caption; with a border-subtle hairline.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, search results, the phone caption; with a border-subtle hairline.

shadows.name: selected
shadows.purpose: The 1 px brass ring of a selected chip, MO level or ml button; follows the resolved temper.

shadows.name: selected-tile
shadows.purpose: Kept as a role; the tile draws its own 2 px brass edge. No glow.

shadows.name: selected-halo
shadows.purpose: Kept as a role; the pressed (i) draws its solid brass disc and the curve handle its own edge. No glow.

shadows.name: list-marker
shadows.purpose: Selected MUI list rows and menu items, and the keyboard-active search option.

shadows.name: scrim-blur
shadows.purpose: Behind the specimen title, over the scrim.

focus.purpose: Every interactive element, never removed; outlined inputs use a 2 px focus-ring border instead.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Colour, background and opacity changes on hover (level switch, (i), MO levels, rows); band marks dimming; Info's "How this was computed" chevron.

motion.name: panel
motion.purpose: Inspector accordion and jobs-page disclosure chevrons, the inspector drawer (16 px slide-in with fade).

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: every transition and animation is instant.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Viewer phone layout and phone body type (theme.ts PHONE_MEDIA).

breakpoints.name: medium
breakpoints.purpose: Viewer: inspector folds to a 44 px bar and opens as a drawer.

breakpoints.name: level-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Viewer top bar: the level switch folds to one button naming the level, opening the four as a list.

breakpoints.name: operate-tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Jobs page: strip regroups, memory moves into details.

breakpoints.name: operate-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Jobs page: strip folds, rows become two-line items.

breakpoints.name: wordmark-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Top bar: wordmark 20/24, bar gaps 16 px.

breakpoints.name: phone-tight
breakpoints.purpose: Phone bar: wordmark 18/22; under 370 px the atom mark hides.

sizes.inspectorDocked: 290px by default; docked, up to min(560px, 45% of the viewport, what leaves the field 520px or more), stored as eov.inspectorWidth, never in a link
sizes.touch: 44px (the hit-area floor of any custom control under 32px tall, drawn by a transparent ::before; dense fields keep their own size)
sizes.stripGroupGap: 12px between groups, 8px between tiles in a group
sizes.stripPeek: 32px of the next group's first tile, clear of the fade
sizes.curveHandle: 10px dot, 2px surface-1 gap, 2px ring (18px drawn); hollow: the 2px ring alone (14px drawn)

moneyPrecision.rule: Two decimals; a row charge under a cent reads "under $0.01".
Four significant figures below a cent (formatUsd).
The meter's micro-dollars ($0.000000, exactUsd) so lines add up to the total.
Never bare: each figure carries its word (held, of, estimated, up to, absorbed by the app).

tempers.derived: accent-text, accent-fill, selected-edge and avatar = accent; rail-active = selected-fill; on-fill = text-1; selected-fill-active = selected-fill with OKLCH L lowered by 0.035 (one surface step), hue and chroma kept
tempers.field: The viewing field and its windows (strip tiles, the phone header) resolve to their mode's explore temper and base sizes at every level ([data-level] [data-theme][data-field]).

viewport.purpose: The viewing field's mode per page mode; the one switch that reverts the dark field.
viewport.pageScope: The inspector drawer, the phone top bar and sheet, pickers and toolbar menus keep the page mode and level.
viewport.fieldScope: The field, its overlays, strip tiles and the phone header wear the field mode at Explore.

graticule.scaleBar: 1 px accent rule; 8 px end ticks; 4 graduations at 4 px; whole-pixel ticks; label text-1 Inter 500 14 px tabular, above the rule; no card.
graticule.export: PNG composites onto canvas-solid of the page mode's field and draws the same bar at export scale in Explore brass.

components.name: Contained Button
components.description: The one primary action in a panel: request, approve, export.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-contained">Approve up to $0.51</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-contained { background: var(--ql-color-accent, #C4A15A); color: var(--ql-color-on-accent, #000000); font: 500 13px/20px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); padding: 6px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-contained:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ql-color-accent, #C4A15A) 85%, #000); } .ds-btn-contained:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ql-color-focus-ring, #D7B46D); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Row Action
components.description: A row's one action: Open result, Follow, Details.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-outlined">Open result</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { background: transparent; color: var(--ql-color-accent-text, #C4A15A); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ql-color-accent, #C4A15A) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px 9px; font: 500 13px/20px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ql-color-accent, #C4A15A) 8%, transparent); border-color: var(--ql-color-accent, #C4A15A); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ql-color-focus-ring, #D7B46D); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chips
components.description: Status filters with a muted count (MUI small outlined chips, 6 px corner); the selected chip takes the Brass Tint, text-1 and the brass edge. The resting outline is MUI's own grey, not a token.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #616161; background: transparent; color: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); font: 400 13px/20px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--ql-color-surface-2, #2A2A28); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ql-color-focus-ring, #D7B46D); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-count { margin-left: 6px; color: var(--ql-color-text-3, #A39A87); } .ds-chip.is-selected, .ds-chip.is-selected:hover { background: var(--ql-color-selected-fill, #403319); border-color: var(--ql-color-selected-edge, #C4A15A); color: var(--ql-color-on-fill, #EEE7D8); } .ds-chip.is-selected .ds-chip-count { color: var(--ql-color-on-fill, #EEE7D8); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A job's status: one word and a dot in its tone (amber when done past its prediction).
components.html: Running Done Failed
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 1px 9px 1px 7px; font: 500 12px/18px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); border: 1px solid var(--ql-color-border-subtle, #353632); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tone); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Outlined search with a leading magnifier; the focused border is the indicator.
components.css: .ds-search { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 260px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ql-color-border-strong, #625238); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ql-color-text-2, #B9AF99); transition: border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-search:hover { border-color: var(--ql-color-text-2, #B9AF99); } .ds-search:focus-within { border: 2px solid var(--ql-color-focus-ring, #D7B46D); padding: 0 11px; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; color: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); font: 400 13px/20px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); }

components.name: Top Bar Tabs
components.description: The 56 px top bar: the brass serif wordmark, then the destinations in nav type, the current one underlined by a 2 px brass selected-edge bar.
components.html: QuantumLabOrbitalsAtomsBondsMolecules
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 20px; height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--ql-color-bg-bar, #141513); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ql-color-border-subtle, #353632); } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: var(--ql-color-text-2, #B9AF99); text-decoration: none; font: 500 14px/20px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); transition: color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ql-color-focus-ring, #D7B46D); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 12px; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--ql-color-selected-edge, #C4A15A); } .ds-topbar { align-items: stretch; } .ds-wordmark { align-self: center; margin-right: 4px; color: var(--ql-color-accent-text, #C4A15A); font: 600 24px/28px var(--ql-font-serif, "Source Serif 4 Variable", "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif); letter-spacing: -0.01em; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Specimen Title Block
components.description: The name of what is drawn, top-left on the dark field: the title names the specimen in the specimen serif with real subscripts, a second serif line (17/24, 400, text-2) inside the h1 names the view of it after a hidden comma, and the plain Inter subtitle says what is drawn, on the 84 % scrim.
components.html:
Hydrogen, 3dz² orbital

electron cloud · 90 % enclosed
components.css: .ds-field { padding: 12px; width: 420px; height: 160px; border-radius: 16px; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 50% 45%, #1B1C19 0%, #10110F 55%, #0B0C0A 100%); } .ds-specimen { display: inline-block; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ql-color-scrim, rgba(16,17,15,0.84)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-specimen h1 { margin: 0; color: #EEE7D8; font: 500 26px/32px var(--ql-font-serif, "Source Serif 4 Variable", "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif); } .ds-specimen h1 sub { font-size: 0.68em; vertical-align: -0.28em; line-height: 0; } .ds-specimen .ds-pause { clip-path: inset(50%); margin-right: -0.3em; } .ds-specimen .ds-view { display: block; color: #B9AF99; font: 400 17px/24px var(--ql-font-serif, "Source Serif 4 Variable", "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif); } .ds-specimen p { margin: 2px 0 0; color: #B9AF99; font: 400 13px/18px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); }

components.name: Engraved Graticule (Scale Bar)
components.description: The field scale bar, straight on the field: a 1 px brass rule, 8 px end ticks and four 4 px graduations, the label above in text-1, tabular figures. No card, no glow.
components.html: 20 a₀
components.css: .ds-field-sm { padding: 16px 20px; width: 220px; background: #10110F; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-scale { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 14px 8px; color: #EEE7D8; font: 500 14px/1 var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-scale-bar { position: relative; height: 9px; box-sizing: border-box; border-bottom: 1px solid #C4A15A; } .ds-scale-bar i { position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 1px; height: 4px; background: #C4A15A; } .ds-scale-bar i.end { height: 8px; }

components.name: Budget Strip
components.description: The month's money on one line of named figures in a 12 px card: Available of cap with a charged/held cap bar, Charged, Held, Projected, and AWS billed against the meter with the gap in words behind one text-button disclosure.
components.html:
Available $7.04 of $8.80
Charged $0.33
Held $1.44 for running jobs
Projected $0.81 by 31 Oct
AWS billed $0.62 to 27 Oct · meter $0.33 · $0.29 more than the meter
components.css: .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(210px, 1fr) auto auto auto auto; background: var(--ql-color-surface-1, #22231F); color: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); border: 1px solid var(--ql-color-border-subtle, #353632); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--ql-shadow-panel, inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03)); font: 400 13px/20px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; padding: 10px 14px; border-left: 1px solid var(--ql-color-border-subtle, #353632); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-cell:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-line { display: block; align-self: center; } .ds-billing { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px 12px; } .ds-label { color: var(--ql-color-text-3, #A39A87); } .ds-value { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); } .ds-gap { color: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); font-weight: 500; } .ds-why { margin: -4px -8px -4px 0; padding: 4px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--ql-color-accent, #C4A15A); font: 500 13px/20px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-why:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ql-color-accent, #C4A15A) 8%, transparent); } .ds-why:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ql-color-focus-ring, #D7B46D); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cap { position: relative; display: block; height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ql-color-surface-3, #323330); overflow: hidden; } .ds-cap-charged, .ds-cap-held { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; } .ds-cap-charged { background: var(--ql-color-accent, #C4A15A); } .ds-cap-held { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ql-color-accent, #C4A15A) 40%, var(--ql-color-surface-3, #323330)); }

components.name: Job Row with Prediction Gauge
components.description: One line per job; the run-time gauge notches the prediction and turns amber past it; the row opens in place.
components.html: 30m 20s of 25m 00s$0.07 of $1.20
components.css: .ds-list { width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; background: var(--ql-color-surface-1, #22231F); color: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); border: 1px solid var(--ql-color-border-subtle, #353632); border-radius: 12px; font: 400 13px/20px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-list td { padding: 6px 12px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row { transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--ql-color-surface-2, #2A2A28); } .ds-disclosure { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px; margin: -4px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-disclosure svg { color: var(--ql-color-text-3, #A39A87); transition: transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-disclosure[aria-expanded="true"] svg { transform: rotate(90deg); } .ds-disclosure:hover b { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-disclosure:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ql-color-focus-ring, #D7B46D); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-muted { color: var(--ql-color-text-3, #A39A87); } .ds-num { text-align: right; } .ds-over { color: var(--ql-color-warning, #F0B429); font-weight: 500; } .ds-gauge { position: relative; display: inline-block; vertical-align: middle; margin: -2px 8px 0 0; width: 56px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ql-color-surface-3, #323330); } .ds-gauge-fill { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ql-color-text-3, #A39A87); } .ds-gauge-over { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 0 999px 999px 0; background: var(--ql-color-warning, #F0B429); } .ds-gauge-notch { position: absolute; top: -3px; bottom: -3px; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); }

components.name: Phase Key Chip
components.description: The canvas key: science swatches on surface-2, with the swatch-ring outline where a hue is under 3:1.
components.html: ψ > 0ψ < 0
components.css: .ds-key { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--ql-color-surface-2, #2A2A28); color: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); font: 400 13px/20px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-key-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-swatch { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ql-color-swatch-ring, rgba(0,0,0,0)); }

components.name: Learning Level Switch
components.description: The top bar's radio group of four levels; the level in use in the Brass Tint with a 1 px inset brass edge. A hidden control leaves one text-3 line; while it still holds a value, the line says so and may end in an accent text action back to the default.
components.html:
Charge and relativity appear at Advanced

Showing Fe²⁺ — charge controls appear at Advanced.
components.css: .ds-level { display: inline-flex; height: 32px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid var(--ql-color-border-strong, #625238); border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-level-opt { appearance: none; border: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0 10px; background: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ql-color-text-2, #B9AF99); font: 400 12px/16px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); transition: color 120ms ease-out, background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-level-opt + .ds-level-opt { border-left: 1px solid var(--ql-color-border-subtle, #353632); } .ds-level-opt:hover { color: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); background: var(--ql-color-surface-2, #2A2A28); } .ds-level-opt.is-checked { color: var(--ql-color-on-fill, #EEE7D8); background: var(--ql-color-selected-fill, #403319); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ql-color-selected-edge, #C4A15A); } .ds-level-opt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ql-color-focus-ring, #D7B46D); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-level-line { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--ql-color-text-3, #A39A87); font: 400 12px/16px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-level-action { padding: 0; margin: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ql-color-accent-text, #C4A15A); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; } .ds-level-action:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-level-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ql-color-focus-ring, #D7B46D); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Info (i) Button and Topic Chip
components.description: An (i) beside its term, brass at rest, surface-2 on hover, surface-3 held under the pointer, with a 44 px hit area. On (aria-pressed) it is a solid brass disc with the on-accent glyph, one step darker while held; no halo. The heading's topic chip wears the Brass Tint and its edge.
components.html:
ShellsSubshells

Info Subshell
components.css: .ds-info-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-info-term { color: var(--ql-color-text-2, #B9AF99); font: 500 12px/16px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-info-term + .ds-info-btn + .ds-info-term { margin-left: 12px; } .ds-info-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: pointer; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: var(--ql-color-accent-text, #C4A15A); transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-info-btn svg { fill: currentColor; } .ds-info-btn:hover { background: var(--ql-color-surface-2, #2A2A28); } .ds-info-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ql-color-focus-ring, #D7B46D); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-info-btn:active { background: var(--ql-color-surface-3, #323330); transition: none; } .ds-info-btn.is-active, .ds-info-btn.is-active:hover { background: var(--ql-color-accent-fill, #C4A15A); border-color: var(--ql-color-accent-fill, #C4A15A); color: var(--ql-color-on-accent, #000000); } .ds-info-btn.is-active:active { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ql-color-accent-fill, #C4A15A) 85%, var(--ql-color-canvas-solid, #10110F)); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ql-color-accent-fill, #C4A15A) 85%, var(--ql-color-canvas-solid, #10110F)); } .ds-info-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--ql-color-text-1, #EEE7D8); font: 600 14px/20px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-topic-chip { display: inline-flex; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ql-color-selected-fill, #403319); color: var(--ql-color-on-fill, #EEE7D8); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ql-color-selected-edge, #C4A15A); font: 600 12px/16px var(--ql-font-sans, "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); }

components.name: Info Section with Fact Grid
components.description: Always open at the top of the inspector (capped at 45 % of it, scrolling inside, a hairline under it): heading with the topic chip, the way back behind a ChevronLeft icon, the serif title (Source Serif 4, 17/24, 600) naming the specimen with the view of it on a second serif line (body size, 400, text-2), plain lead, facts (labels max-content, values right-aligned beside them, wrapping in their own column at no-break boundaries only), a topic's marks list, then How this was computed with its trailing ExpandMore (Method · Limits · Sources under caption-size h3s in text-2, a part with nothing in it unheaded, one fold for all three); an eased three-stop tonal fade while more is below.
components.html:
Info Molecular orbitals

Molecular orbitals

narrative.overview:
QuantumLab is a precise scientific instrument, not a showcase. The specimen (the computed orbital, density or molecule) is lit inside a dark viewing field, and everything around it is matte metal and engraved type: obsidian or warm ivory panels, hairline rules, one matte brass for what you can act on and what is selected, and three serif names (the QuantumLab wordmark, the specimen's title, Info's title) set like an instrument's engraving. On the owner's Operate pages the same metal holds the month's money and jobs. The only loud colours on screen are the science colours and the status colours, and both mean something.

Density is deliberate. The viewer is a fixed full-window workstation (top bar; Explore, viewing field, inspector) at 13 px body text; the Operate surfaces are scrolling documents on the same tokens, built from one budget strip, a compact chart band drawn on the page itself, and one-line rows that open in place. Every figure carries its unit and its word ("of", "held", "charged", "so far"), set in tabular figures so columns of money and minutes align.

Two page modes (the theme switch names them Obsidian, dark, and Ivory, light) share every token role; four learning levels temper them slightly. Basics is polished brass for younger learners (warmer grounds, brighter brass, 14 px body, softer corners), Explore is the reference palette, and Advanced and Research grow quieter and more neutral toward a pewter brass for experienced scientists. A temper moves warmth and brass brightness only, never hue, never layout. The viewing field stays dark in both page modes and wears its mode's Explore temper at every level, so switching level or mode never redraws the picture. The system is MUI 7 driven entirely from `src/design/tokens.ts` (tokens.css is generated from it; `theme.ts` builds one MUI theme per mode and level). The world refuses the generic blue SaaS panel and every literal laboratory costume: no gears, rivets, parchment or gold gradients, and no glows.
keyCharacteristics: Matte brass on obsidian (dark) or bronze on warm ivory (light); one accent, used for action and selection only.
A dark viewing field in both page modes, framed by the engraved graticule: a fine brass scale bar with graduations and a warm neutral axis ink.
Source Serif 4 in exactly three places (wordmark, specimen title, Info title); Inter Variable for every control, label and number, in tabular figures.
Selection is a brass-tinted fill, a brass edge and a weight step, never colour alone; no glow anywhere.
Four level tempers in warmth and brass brightness only; Basics also reads larger and rounder.
Science colours untouched in every mode and level; status colours carry meaning only.
Short ease-out motion (120 / 180 ms), zero under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Science Is Not Style Rule
rules.body: Phase, density and ESP colours are never whitened, tinted, darkened or swapped per mode, level or look. Where a phase hue falls under 3:1 on its panel (the light mode's orange), a `swatch-ring` outline carries the contrast; the hue stays.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Status Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red and the running accent appear only where they state an outcome, and every use is keyed (a legend, a chip label, or words). Amber means "past a prediction" at any overrun, with no tolerance, or "billed past the approved maximum, absorbed by the app".

rules.name: The Selected-Ink Rule
rules.body: `text-3` and `accent-text` never sit on `selected-fill` (they measure 4.32 to 4.43:1 there in some tempers); a selected row, chip or option draws `on-fill` or `text-2` (pinned by `tests/a11y/selected_ink.test.ts`).

rules.name: The One Brass Voice Rule
rules.body: The brass marks actions, selection, the wordmark, the graticule, the field's ring highlight (a pointer's mark) and the one money line; it is never a section tint, a decorative stroke, a gradient or a background wash.

rules.name: The Temper, Not Hue Rule
rules.body: A learning level changes the chrome's warmth and the brass's brightness only (Basics warmer and more golden, Advanced and Research progressively more neutral on the brass's own hue). It never shifts hue, never moves the layout, and never touches the science colours or the viewing field.

rules.name: The Dark Field Rule
rules.body: The viewing field and everything drawn on it (title, toolbar, scale bar, keys, strip, notices, the phone header) wear `VIEWPORT_MODE`'s mode, which is dark for both page modes, at that mode's Explore temper at every level. Page chrome that sits inside the field (the inspector drawer, the phone top bar and sheet, pickers, menus opened from the toolbar) keeps the page's mode and level. `VIEWPORT_MODE` in tokens.ts is the one switch that would give a light page its light field back.

rules.name: The Three Serif Places Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 sets the wordmark, the specimen title (and the phone caption's name) and Info's title, nothing else. Every control, label, number and running sentence is Inter.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that can sit above or beside another (money, durations, memory, ticks, the scale bar's label) is set with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` (`.ql-tabular`).

rules.name: The Phone Fourteen Rule
rules.body: Body steps to 14 px under the phone query; captions and ticks do not grow. Basics reads body 14 and caption 13 at every width; the viewing field puts the base sizes back.

rules.name: The No Shouting Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels and no tracked-out small caps. Inter chrome stays at or under 20 px; only the serif names go larger.

rules.name: The Typeset Science Rule
rules.body: Names of what is drawn carry real subscripts: an orbital's 3d<sub>z²</sub>, an MO's 1σ<sub>g</sub>, an irrep's 1b<sub>1</sub>, a point group's C<sub>2v</sub> or T<sub>d</sub> (everything past the first letter in a real `<sub>`, so any suffix works), a quantity's R<sub>e</sub>, and in the serif titles a formula's digits too (H<sub>2</sub>O), because Source Serif's subsets carry no subscript glyphs; an underscore is never shown. In the serif names a subscript drops and shrinks (0.68 em, −0.28 em, line height 0) without growing the line box. Signs are a true minus (U+2212); values outside the plain range read "2.66 × 10⁻²", never e-notation. A surface that cannot hold markup (the document title, an export caption, an accessible name built as a string) takes the flat Unicode form ("3dz²", "1b₁", "C₂ᵥ"); a spoken name takes plain digits ("H2O", "1b1", "3dz²"), because screen readers voice Unicode subscript digits inconsistently. One parser feeds all three forms (`src/format/sci.ts`, `src/format/subscripts.ts`, `OrbitalLabel`, `PointGroupLabel`), so they never disagree.

rules.name: The eV First Rule
rules.body: An energy reads in electron-volts first with hartree in parentheses, held on one line: "−5.41 eV (−0.199 Ha)". A difference carries its sign either way ("+9.05 eV (+0.333 Ha)") at three significant figures, so nothing rounds to "−0.00 eV"; a total energy keeps Ha to five places. One Ha→eV factor (CODATA 2018) lives in `src/format/energy.ts`. The rule covers the Atoms subshell chips (eV alone to three figures, "−8.03 eV", with the full text in the chip's name and tooltip) and the Atoms orbital-energies table (eV before Ha, each column headed by its bare unit, "eV" and "Ha", with the accessible names "Energy (eV)" and "Energy (Ha)"; its own precision is under Orbital Energies Table), the MO level tooltips, the H₂⁺ curve note and the Molecules provenance (totals and corrections with Ha at the job's six places). An eV figure of 1000 or more is a whole number ("−1339 eV"), never "−1.34 × 10³ eV".

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the chrome glows: no halo, no bloom, no coloured shadow. A state is a brass edge, a tint and a weight; light belongs to the specimen alone.

rules.name: The Tonal Scroll Cue Rule
rules.body: A scroller with more below it says so with a tonal fade, not a shadow, glow, arrow or "More": the last ~24 px fade out through a `mask-image` while (and only while) `scrollTop + clientHeight < scrollHeight`. Info's fade is eased in three stops (half, an eighth, then clear) so it reads as fading out, not as a cut line; where the scroller has a hairline under it (Info in the inspector), the mask keeps that last pixel opaque so the hairline stays drawn; the phone sheet, which has none, fades to its edge. The mask is never animated, so reduced motion has nothing to stop. It works the same in both modes.

rules.name: The Glow Finish Is The Owner's Rule
rules.body: The 3D Glow finish (`src/orbital_glow.ts`, GLOW_TUNING) is the specimen's own presentation, not chrome, and its values were tuned live by the owner; they are recorded there, not here, and are not restyled. The No Glow Rule does not reach it.

rules.name: The Real Icon Rule
rules.body: A control draws an MUI icon, aria-hidden, never a text glyph (‹ › ▾ ▴), and a `<details>` disclosure shows a trailing ExpandMore that turns 180° in place of the browser's marker.

rules.name: The Engraved, Not Lit Rule
rules.body: The graticule is chrome: thin, brass and still. It never gains a card, a glow or a science colour.

rules.name: The Hide, Don't Grey Rule
rules.body: A control above the reader's level is absent, not disabled. Its place holds one quiet line saying where it appears, or what it still holds; a greyed control is never shown.

rules.name: The Plain First Rule
rules.body: Every explanation starts plain and grows by band. A scientific term with an (i) or a reference never appears below the level its band opens at.

rules.name: The One Home Per Number Rule
rules.body: Each figure has one place on screen. A key number lives in Info's facts, a control's value in that control's readout, a scale in the field's key; the specimen subtitle is one plain line that restates neither the title nor Info's numbers, and adds the method only at Research. A panel line that would repeat an Info fact is dropped.

rules.name: The One Pressed (i) Rule
rules.body: At most one (i) is pressed at a time, and only the one whose press set the topic; a second (i) for the same term elsewhere stays at rest.

rules.name: The True Height Rule
rules.body: An MO level sits at its own energy on the diagram's one scale. A collision is cleared sideways, never by moving a level up or down, and anything not drawn to scale sits behind a marked break.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every selected state wears three things: the Brass Tint (or, on a tile or tab, no fill), a brass edge (1 px on controls, 2 px on tabs and tiles, a 2 px inset marker on list rows), and a weight or ink step; `aria-pressed`, `aria-selected` or `aria-checked` says it too. A tint alone, or a solid brass fill that hides its own edge, is never a selection.

rules.name: The Pressed Step Rule
rules.body: Every custom control shows a press: one tonal step past hover, instantly, in tokens, never a size or a position change; a selected control keeps its edge and its tint darkens to `selected-fill-active`; a disabled one is `text-3` with no hover and a default cursor; a control under 32 px tall keeps its look and gets a transparent 44 × 44 hit area, unless 44 px would cover its neighbour.

dos: **Do** take every colour, size, radius and duration from `tokens.ts` through `tokens.css` or the MUI theme; add a role there, in every temper, before using a new value.
**Do** temper a level in warmth and brass brightness only, from the Explore base, and check every text role at 4.5:1 and every edge and focus ring at 3:1 in all eight mode × level tempers.
**Do** keep the viewing field dark in both page modes, at its mode's Explore temper, and put page chrome that sits inside it back in the page's mode and level.
**Do** mark a selection with the Brass Tint, a brass edge and a weight or ink step together.
**Do** set the wordmark, the specimen title and Info's title in Source Serif 4 with real `<sub>` digits, and everything else in Inter.
**Do** set every comparable number in tabular figures and pair it with its unit and its word ("$0.04 of $0.51", "1.20 so far of 2.10 GB").
**Do** draw an overrun in amber however small, and key every status tone in a legend or in words.
**Do** say an off-scale reference (a cap, a limit) in words rather than drawing it at a false height.
**Do** open a record's detail in place under its row, one step away, rather than navigating off the list.
**Do** keep a visible 2 px focus ring on every interactive element and honour reduced motion (hover 120 ms, panels 180 ms, ease-out, 0 ms when reduced).
**Do** give secondary text a real colour token (`text-2`, `text-3`), never opacity, so contrast tests see the painted colour.
**Do** hide a control above the reader's level and leave its one-line pointer, or its held-value note while it still holds a value.
**Do** order Info as title, plain lead, facts, notes, technical, then "How this was computed", and keep Basics and Explore leads to 3 lines or fewer.
**Do** give each number one home, and set energies eV first with Ha in parentheses.
**Do** put an (i) beside the word it explains, with `aria-pressed` and `aria-controls`, and let only one be pressed.
**Do** set names of what is drawn with real subscripts and a true minus; flat Unicode where markup cannot go, plain digits where it is spoken.
**Do** stand a control over the plot it moves: inset its track by the plot's own gutters, and draw its handle hollow when the value is off the plot.
**Do** say what a corrected link changed in its notice, with a plain spoken copy, and clear it on the reader's first view change.

**Do** give every custom control a pressed step (one tonal step past hover, instant, no size change), a disabled look (`text-3`, no hover, default cursor) and a 44 × 44 hit area where its box is under 32 px, unless 44 px would cover its neighbour.
donts: **Don't** whiten, tint, darken or swap the phase, density or ESP colours for any mode, level or finish.
**Don't** shift hue between levels, or let a level move the layout or redraw the picture.
**Don't** add a glow, halo, bloom or coloured shadow to any chrome; and don't add gears, rivets, parchment, gold gradients or any other laboratory costume.
**Don't** use the brass as a section tint, a decorative stroke, a gradient or a background wash, and don't use green, amber, red or the running accent as decoration or emphasis.
**Don't** select with colour alone, or with a solid brass fill whose edge cannot be seen.
**Don't** set the serif anywhere but the three names, or set anything under 11 px, or uppercase or track a label or button.
**Don't** build KPI-tile grids or wide spreadsheets that push cost off screen on Operate pages; use the strip, the band and one-line rows.
**Don't** grey out a control the level hides, or let lowering the level change what is drawn.
**Don't** print e-notation, a hyphen for a minus, or an underscore in a name.
**Don't** repeat a figure across the subtitle, a panel line, the field's key and Info.
**Don't** cue more content with a drop shadow, a glow, an arrow or a "More" label; use the tonal fade.
**Don't** draw a chevron, caret or close mark as a text glyph (‹ › ▾ ▴), or leave a `<details>` on the browser's marker; use the MUI icon, aria-hidden.
